_comment: One character set. Put <color>_<mood>.gif files next to this file; every color found becomes selectable in the Sprites panel. 'colors' only adds a label and swatch (the agent's accent color) and may list explicit 'files' per mood. 'aliases' lists the file suffixes a mood accepts (first wins). 'fallback' lets a missing mood reuse another one. 'default' is used for moods a color has no file for. 'suggest' is only the initial color for agents that have no saved choice. Moods: idle, think, held, sleep, pet, clap, stretch, shy, peek, bored, failed, walkfront, walkback.
